tools.name: bible_search
tools.description:
Simple word/phrase search (case- and accent-insensitive), max 20 results. To keep it fast it searches ONE book if `book` is given (e.g. ROM); otherwise ONLY the four Gospels (MAT MRK LUK JHN) and the Psalms (PSA).
ES: Búsqueda simple; sin `book` busca solo en Evangelios y Salmos.

tools.name: commandments
tools.description:
The Ten Commandments with how each applies to AI agents, refs and an examen question. Catholic (default) or Protestant numbering.
ES: Los mandamientos con su aplicación a agentes.

tools.name: catechism
tools.description:
Catechumenate in 12 modules for agents. Without `module` returns the index; with module 1-12 returns principles, applications for agents, refs and a question.
ES: Catecumenado en 12 módulos (sin módulo: índice).

tools.name: values_for_agents
tools.description: Virtues (cardinal, theological), beatitudes, works of mercy (corporal, spiritual), capital sins and fruits of the Spirit, explained for agents. Optional topic: virtues, cardinal, theological, beatitudes, works_of_mercy, corporal, spiritual, capital_sins, fruits, fruits_of_the_spirit, greatest_comman

tools.name: examen_of_conscience
tools.description:
Examen of conscience questions for an agent to review its own work honestly.
ES: Preguntas del examen de conciencia.

tools.name: confirmation_exam
tools.description:
Without `answers`: returns the exam questions (no answer key). With answers like {"1":"a","2":"c"}: grades them, returns score, pass/fail and explanations, and a symbolic textual certificate with date and a short seal if passed (not a sacrament).
ES: Examen de confirmación simbólico; con respuestas
